svg.title: KCD2 layered scene sampling
svg.desc: Four-panel method figure showing boundary poses, a convex hull, five-layer point packing, and multi-view orientation allocation using committed KCD2 scan-plan data.
svg.text: From Sparse Boundary Poses to a Multi-View Scan Plan
The KCD2 Scene 1 plan uses a convex-hull model, five vertical layers, and 22 orientations per retained spatial point.
27 unique boundary XYZ -> 19 hull vertices -> 131 safe positions -> 2,882 explicit camera samples
All counts and layer heights are read directly from scene_1_5layer_hull_plan.json.
